verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents live dashboards that show compliance posture across multiple frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.). A 'Framework Health' API page suggests per-framework health tracking, but the evidence never describes a readiness view that breaks out passing controls, open gaps and remaining work, or a single readiness percentage. Missing for 10: documented per-framework readiness percentage, breakdown of passing vs failing controls, remaining-work view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, a readiness view shows exactly how far I am from audit-ready per framework — passing controls, open gaps, and what's left, as one honest percentage

citations.quote: Real-time visibility: Always know your compliance posture with live dashboards and reports.
One platform, multiple frameworks: Manage SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and others in one place.
Audit readiness by design: Maintain readiness with continuous monitoring, alerts, and evidence collection.
